headline: Indian markets reopen after holiday; Nifty eyes 24,800 support as GIFT Nifty signals positive start despite US inflation.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian markets reopen today after being closed on November 10 for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
GIFT Nifty indicates a positive start, jumping 1% as crude oil prices test the $90 per barrel mark.
Analysts suggest a buy-on-dips strategy as Nifty bulls find strong technical support at the 24,800 level.
US markets ended lower as hot inflation data and Federal Reserve comments heightened global interest rate worries.
whatHappening: Patna Municipal Corporation (PMC) debuts on the NSE with a Rs 200-crore bond listing, a first for Bihar.
India VIX has surged 68% in the last 47 days, indicating a significant rise in market volatility.
Sensex and Nifty 50 have demonstrated strength by rising over 6% during the past five trading sessions.
Global chipmakers are warning that high AI demand is creating supply chain bottlenecks for the automotive sector.
summary: Indian markets reopen after the Diwali holiday with Nifty showing support at 24,800 and GIFT Nifty signaling a positive start. While domestic indices have rallied 6% recently, global headwinds from US inflation and Fed rate hike concerns persist. Investors are monitoring key stocks like Bajaj Finance and Tata Motors alongside the landmark bond listing of PMC.
